title: Developmental EAL/2 synthetic bias-attribution route study
question: On twelve frozen author-created synthetic engineering episodes, how does assigned direct versus independent-challenge model analysis change a fully warranted bias disposition and unsupported strong attribution?

scope.system_or_population: The 12 synthetic families and 48 generated process/rival/missing-link/insufficient cases in cases.json, not real engineers.
scope.conditions: Three requested OpenAI model IDs; one direct call versus two independent serially executed calls with agreement-only deterministic synthesis; frozen prompts, answer contract and case records.
scope.spatial_scope: One repository study and provider API execution.
scope.temporal_scope: One frozen developmental run on 2026-09-24 or a versioned later execution interval; aliases logged per request.
exclusions: Causal decomposition of independent challenge versus additional model calls

claims.statement: Assignment to the two-call independent-challenge route changes fully warranted dispositions within the fixed synthetic case suite relative to direct analysis.
claims.scope_limit: Finite author-created cases, actual returned model identities and exact route implementations only; no human-bias mitigation or topology mechanism inference.
claims.success_consequence: Report a bounded developmental route difference with family-level uncertainty.
claims.failure_consequence: Report no detected gain or a harmful route difference; keep future testing separate.

assumptions.statement: The authored gold and stable evidence IDs encode the stipulated episode consistently across both arms.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Offline schema checks and independent content review; parse/typecheck source in full tree.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend affected case scores and do not infer an EAL argument effect.

assumptions.statement: Both arms see the same case evidence and differ only in the declared route and its compute.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Hash prompt materials, inspect answer-key exclusion and compare public case payloads.

assumptions.statement: Returned alias identity is stable within each compared block or reported separately.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Log returned response.model, response ID and UTC; stop or split on drift.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Do not pool alias responses as one model.

assumptions.statement: Author-created cases correspond to new real engineering decisions.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Unestablished; recruit independent human cases in later investigation.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Do not generalise beyond the fixed synthetic corpus.

hypotheses.label: Pragmatic route gain
hypotheses.statement: The two-call challenge yields more fully warranted dispositions than the one-call direct route in the fixed suite.
hypotheses.scope: Frozen synthetic suite and returned model identity.

hypotheses.label: No pragmatic route gain
hypotheses.statement: The two-call challenge does not increase fully warranted dispositions, or reduces them by abstaining on supported cases.
hypotheses.scope: Frozen synthetic suite and returned model identity.

hypotheses.label: Route statistical null
hypotheses.statement: H0: Delta_Y <= 0 for the fixed family-average comparison; Stage A reports an interval without a confirmatory superiority decision.

predictions.expected_pattern: Positive family-averaged paired difference in fully warranted disposition.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: No effect-size threshold fixed for developmental Stage A.
predictions.time_window: One assigned case response, before feedback.
predictions.tolerance: Exact stipulated label/options/role evidence with masked review of factual additions.

predictions.expected_pattern: Nonpositive disposition difference, or a higher abstention rate with reduced supported-case recall.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: No threshold fixed for developmental Stage A.
predictions.tolerance: Exact synthetic supported-status and resolution definitions.

constructs.name: Fully warranted synthetic disposition
constructs.definition: Correct bounded status and mechanism, required role evidence IDs, rival/defeater disposition, underlying defect and safe correction under the author-scripted record.
constructs.scope: Only the stipulated synthetic process record.
validity_evidence: Deterministic fields can be compared with a frozen case oracle.
validity_threats: Oracle and case source share an author.
Valid real alternatives may be excluded.
No measurement of an actual human process.

constructs.name: Strong unsupported attribution
constructs.definition: Status EPISODE-SUPPORTED or stronger for a mechanism not supported by a negative or insufficient scripted record.
validity_threats: Weak categorical accusatory prose needs masked manual coding.

constructs.name: Resolved supported case
constructs.definition: A positive process case receives a specific supported status rather than UNDECIDED or refusal.
validity_threats: Overly rigid exact matching may penalise qualified alternatives.

design.rationale: Every frozen synthetic case is assigned to both routes under each requested model; assignment order is seeded and outputs are retained.
design.setting: Author-created synthetic EAL/2 source and process ledger, Responses API.
design.temporal_structure: Pilot of first two families followed by the remaining fixed plan only if operational gates pass.
design.assignment_method: Seeded random call order within frozen case/model/route schedule.
design.allocation_concealment: Gold remains in local fixture/scorer and is omitted from request body.
design.masking: Prompts do not reveal gold; analysts do not see one another; deterministic synthesis follows fixed rule.
design.comparator: Direct one-call route versus independent two-call agreement route.

units.target_population_or_system: Fixed twelve synthetic families, not a sampled population.
units.sampling_frame: All twelve preauthored episodes in cases.json.
units.experimental_unit: One fresh model request; route final output is composed from one or two requests.
units.observational_unit: Response or failed/unknown attempt, plus final route output.
units.assignment_unit: Case/model/route block with seeded request ordering.
units.analysis_unit: Independent synthetic family; four variants remain clustered.
inclusion_criteria: All twelve frozen families and four variants each
exclusion_criteria: Changed model identities analysed as separate cohort
units.recruitment_or_selection: Author-designed cases selected for mechanism diversity; no representative sampling.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Assign direct one-call or independent two-call separately prompted mechanism/rival analysis with deterministic agreement-only synthesis.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Model route outputs and error patterns.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Frozen run.py request bodies and route synthesis.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One versus two API requests per case/model, maximum output fixed in freeze.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Fresh independent calls before private scoring feedback.
manipulation_checks: Freeze contains one versus two distinct calls
No analyst sees the other analyst response
recovery_checks: Fresh sessions and no retry on unknown outcome

controls.description: Same family includes a documented stronger technical or organisational rival.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Bad outcome treated as proof of bias.
controls.implementation: Rival variant with explicit defeater and matched contrast.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Strong attribution on this variant counts as false attribution.

controls.description: Rotate absent exposure, absent choice and evidenced absent uptake across twelve families.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Cue presence mistaken for uptake or discretionary response.
controls.implementation: Four families per missing premise with distinct gold status.

controls.description: Six compatible and six undecided records lack necessary process or contrast.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Uncertainty is forced into categorical diagnosis.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Report both overclaiming and indiscriminate abstention.

confounds.description: Independent route uses two calls where direct uses one.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Extra compute could explain an observed pragmatic gain.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Report route effect only; plan call-matched Stage B.
confounds.diagnostic: Compare cost, tokens and coverage; no mechanism attribution in A.

confounds.description: All case scripts and gold share design authors.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Rubric artefacts can favour taught prompt structure.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Independent masked cases/review in Stage C.

estimands.population_or_system: Fixed twelve synthetic case families conditional on returned model identity.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-family-weighted paired mean difference, variants averaged within family.
estimands.interpretation: Pragmatic route change in warranted synthetic disposition, with extra computation included.

estimands.population_or_system: Fixed twelve synthetic case families conditional on returned model identity.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-family-weighted paired mean difference, variants averaged within family.
estimands.interpretation: Pragmatic route change in strong false attribution among negative cases.

estimands.population_or_system: Fixed twelve synthetic case families conditional on returned model identity.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-family-weighted paired mean difference, variants averaged within family.
estimands.interpretation: Pragmatic route change in supported-case resolution/coverage.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: All fixed cases assigned both routes; request order seeded. Route includes call count, prompts and deterministic synthesis together. Synthetic oracle quality is not independently established.
identified_parameters: Paired route outcome differences on author-labelled fixed cases, conditional on stable response model.
nonidentified_alternatives: Independent challenge versus extra compute and agreement abstention
threats: Wrong content scope in generated EAL source

sampling.method: Complete fixed developmental case census with family-level precision report.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: 12 families × 4 variants × 3 requested models × (1+2 calls) = 432 assigned calls, 288 final outputs.
sampling.dependence_structure: Case variants and repeated model comparisons share family; returned aliases may change by time.
sampling.multiplicity: Three model-specific contrasts and outcomes reported separately; no confirmatory ranking.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Failures and unknown calls retained in assignment denominator.
sampling.result: Feasibility and effect interval only; 12 families cannot establish small superiority or safety margins.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Family bootstrap/permutation, oracle ambiguity audit, fail-all versus response-only estimates.
sampling.stopping_implications: Operational 72-call gate ($5), then $25 cumulative cap; no outcome-based stopping.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Parse frozen schema, retain all assignments; group four variants per family and composition calls by case/model/route.
analysis.exclusion_lock: Only explicitly non-scored endpoint probes excluded; no post-hoc failed-call exclusion.

models.model_or_procedure: Equal-family paired differences with family-level permutation or bootstrap intervals; descriptive by returned model identity.
assumptions: Stipulated gold valid for this finite corpus

contrasts: Independent versus direct within each model on same cases
analysis.uncertainty: Report family-level intervals and individual family results; no call-level binomial independence.
analysis.multiplicity: No confirmatory discovery claim; report all planned contrasts, future Holm gate for selected confirmation.
analysis.missing_data: Failures count unsuccessful in system outcome; unknown billed attempts are retained unresolved and not retried.
analysis.stopping_rule: Fixed 72-call operational pilot and 432-call ceiling, with preflight reservations and $5/$25 caps; no score-driven stop.
software_and_versions: run.py and analyse.py digests in frozen manifest
EAL/2 parser revision from full repository
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Insufficient independent families, invalid content or model drift yields feasibility report only.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Valid reference and positive Delta_Y without clear safety deterioration, with supported recall retained.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Describe observed route gain on fixed synthetic cases; no superiority certification in Stage A.

claim_effects.rationale: Bounded route difference is observed on this exact corpus.
claim_effects.scope_limit: No topology-component, human or population claim.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Suspend if oracle/content/model identity check fails.
decision_matrix.next_action: Independent call-matched Stage B and held-out confirmation.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Nonpositive Delta_Y or supported recall reduced by abstention.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Do not advance route as beneficial.

claim_effects.rationale: Fixed suite does not show the proposed pragmatic gain.

decision_matrix.next_action: Inspect failure cases; do not select by post-hoc tuning.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Wide interval, unanticipated pattern, reference dispute, failed API or material alias drift.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report feasibility, uncertainty and invalid/unknown denominators.

claim_effects.rationale: Observation cannot distinguish a useful gain from a rival or invalid data.

decision_matrix.next_action: Repair measurement and freeze a new independent cohort.

risks.mechanism: Author case content and gold share design assumptions.
risks.prevention: Freeze cases, independently inspect content and reference statuses.

risks.mechanism: Luna/Sol aliases may change during calls.
risks.prevention: Randomise order and log returned model per request.

falsification_checks: Different status on relevant process/rival evidence
reporting_controls: Freeze and retain every assigned attempt

ethics_and_safety.rationale: Synthetic API calls only; no human subjects in Stage A, but the supplied credential and billing require protection.
stopping_rules: Halt on uncertain usage, drift or exceeded conservative reserve
post_stop_actions: Retain incomplete attempts and report exact reason; no implicit retry

apparatus_or_data: 48 synthetic generated sources and process ledgers
feasibility.access: Provider network path and models must pass probe; current environment may block API egress.
blockers: Independent human review and fresh cohorts are not present
feasibility.fallback: Publish offline protocol and validation; no fabricated API outcomes.

reproducibility.registration: Frozen manifest is internal development registration; no external preregistration.
immutable_materials: model request JSON and hashed freeze
reproducibility.data_plan: WAL retains raw request IDs, responses, errors, usage and answer options without key.
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Seed 240924 in freeze, with shuffled call order and stable option permutations.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: SHA-256 of fixtures, prompts, source, request and response identities.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Any changed prompt/case/model starts a versioned cohort, preserving prior attempts.
reproducibility.replication_plan: Fresh independent families and masked human gold review, followed by human trial.
